findings.span: The two frames are AI illustrations, not results.
findings.why: A two-frame skin visual on an acne-category serum reads as a before/after pair even with the label, and ASCI's AI-labelling guidelines prohibit AI-made result images regardless of a label. Acceptable only if the frames are clearly not a skin-change comparison.
findings.fix: Replace the two AI frames with a pack shot or texture image and drop the 'two frames' line.

tone_read: Calm and factual with an honest AI disclosure, and no fear or hype. The 'two frames' wording points at a before/after-style visual, which is not Minimalist's educational register.
language_read: The 2% strength is stated exactly and no efficacy claims are made. The 'strength stated on the page' phrase is internal-sounding copy.
